name: zvid_image_query_bytes_per_pixel
description: zVid_Image::QueryBytesPerPixel returns one or two bytes per pixel from bit 0 of the image format byte.
known_limits: No VC COFF byte target covers 0x46ec20 yet; current evidence is functional only.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly/decompilation at 0x46ec20 validates reading the second byte of zVid_Image::formatFlagsPacked, masking bit 0, and returning 1 when the bit is clear or 2 when set.
The native zVid image smoke exercises the format-code setup path and verifies QueryBytesPerPixel returns 2 for format code 1.
